title: Background Processes
subtitle: Everything Puppeteer started that is still running: sessions, app services, and processes left behind.

sections.orphanHint: Started by Puppeteer before it last quit. Nothing owns them now.
sections.leftoverHint: Their session ended, but processes it started are still alive.
sections.servicesHint: Puppeteer's own helpers (translation, probes, MCP tests, ssh-agent).

actions.stopTitle: Stop gracefully (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 3 s)

confirm.stopLeftoversMessage: {n} leftover process will be stopped. | {n} leftover processes will be stopped.
confirm.stopAllMessage: This stops every tracked process ({n}), including running sessions and Puppeteer's app services. Running sessions are cancelled.
confirm.forceMessage: "{label}" will be killed immediately without a chance to clean up.
confirm.stopSessionMessage: "{label}" is still running. Stopping it also cancels the run.

empty.title: Nothing is running in the background
empty.hint: Sessions, dev servers and helpers started by Puppeteer show up here while they run.

dock.label: {n} background process | {n} background processes
dock.title: Processes still running after their session ended. Click to review.

orphanPrompt.title: {n} process is still running from the previous session | {n} processes are still running from the previous session
orphanPrompt.message: Puppeteer quit while these were running. They keep using CPU and memory until stopped.

quit.title: Quit Puppeteer?
quit.strayHint: Leftover processes can keep running after Puppeteer quits; they show up as leftovers next launch.

devServers.title: Dev servers
devServers.hint: Declared by the project in .puppeteer/dev-servers.json. Started without your tokens in their environment.
devServers.noProjects: Add a project to use its dev servers.
devServers.missing: This project declares no dev servers. Create {path} to start them by name, here or from an agent:
devServers.rules: command is one program, args an array of plain values, cwd relative to the project; env is not supported.
devServers.empty: No usable server is declared in {path}.
devServers.portBusy: Port {port} is held by a process Puppeteer did not start; it is left alone.
devServers.logTruncated: Only the end of the log is shown.
